name: Tab sessions
responsibility: What each browser tab owns: its coordinator and voice, and one workhorse for each checkout it works in, found by the thread a notification or tool call names
description: One record per tab session, opened when a pane socket of the tab connects and built by codex-workbench-session-factories.ts. The coordinator, voice, spoken approval, coordinator tools and callbacks are the tab's; the workhorses are built on first use, one for each checkout. A notification goes to the session that owns its thread, or to every session when no session owns the thread yet, and a workhorse thread belongs to its workhorse. A tool call from a thread that no session owns is refused, so a running turn never waits on nobody. It notes the conversation shown when each coordinator turn starts and the work each workhorse's operations give. When a session ends, every link is cleared, its approvals are cancelled, its voice and board news stop, and its threads are unsubscribed once no turn runs on them.
